name: skip-if-branch
description: skip_if selects correct conditional branch based on vars.ROUTE

ROUTE.description: Routing variable; when set, triage auto-advances to main_track

hotfix_track.directive: Terminal state reached when ROUTE was not set.

main_track.directive: Terminal state reached when ROUTE was set.

triage.directive:
When ROUTE is set, skip_if fires and auto-advances to main_track via the
conditional transition. When ROUTE is unset, falls through to hotfix_track.
